2608.25970.title: PANDA - Prototype-Anchored Alignment for Partially Unpaired Multimodal Learning, with Applications to Alzheimers MRI and TCGA Pathology
2608.25970.paper_summary: Multimodal medical prediction often faces incomplete pairing: auxiliary modalities with complementary signal are available for only a subset of subjects (or none) and cannot be assumed at deployment. We introduce PANDA (Prototype Anchored Data Alignment), a two-stage framework that transfers auxiliary information to a primary-modality model without auxiliary inputs at inference. Stage 1 learns a shared embedding from the paired subset and estimates class prototypes from auxiliary modalities; Stage 2 trains the primary encoder on all subjects using cross-entropy plus alignment to the frozen prototypes. Because supervision is defined at the class-prototype level, PANDA accommodates arbitrary pairing rates, including zero subject overlap. We evaluate PANDA on two applications. On a 1,021-subject multi-scanner ADNI cohort, we perform AD/CN classification with three auxiliary modalities at distinct pairing rates: tabular scores (44.8%), FDG-PET (18.7%), and external handwriting kinematics (0% overlap). Relative to the same-backbone MRI-only baseline, PANDA attains AUC 0.868 +-0.020 (+7.9pp) and reduces 1.5T CN false positives by 24.3pp; on a fully trainable Conv5-FC3 backbone it reaches AUC 0.893 (best overall). A pairing-rate ablation shows that the joint anchor remains within seed noise from 75% to 5% pairing. On TCGA-Lung survival prediction from whole-slide images with RNA-seq as auxiliary data, PANDA improves over WSI-only on 2-year OS (AUC +3.5pp) and Cox PH (C-index +9.0pts) and outperforms full-fusion training, which underperforms WSI-only, while requiring no RNA at inference; wide confidence intervals on this smaller cohort keep the gains below conventional significance. Overall, PANDA provides a deployment-oriented mechanism for leveraging incomplete auxiliary modalities to improve primary-modality prediction.
2608.25970.paper_summary_zh: 多模態醫療預測通常面臨不完整的配對：輔助模態的互補信號僅對部分受試者（或無）可用，且在部署時無法假設。我們引入了PANDA（原型錨定數據對齊），這是一個兩階段框架，能在推理時將輔助信息轉移到主要模態模型，而無需輔助輸入。第一階段從配對的子集學習共享嵌入，並從輔助模態估計類別原型；第二階段使用交叉熵加上對凍結原型的對齊，對所有受試者訓練主要編碼器。由於監督是在類別原型級別定義的，PANDA可以適應任意的配對率，包括零受試者重疊。我們在兩個應用上評估PANDA。在一個包含1,021名受試者的多掃描儀ADNI隊列中，我們在不同的配對率下進行AD/CN分類，使用三種輔助模態：表格分數（44.8%）、FDG-PET（18.7%）和外部手寫運動學（0%重疊）。相對於相同骨幹的僅MRI基線，PANDA達到AUC 0.868 ±0.020（+7.9pp），並將1.5T CN的假陽性減少了24.3pp；在完全可訓練的Conv5-FC3骨幹上，它達到AUC 0.893（最佳整體）。配對率消融實驗顯示，聯合錨定在75%到5%的配對中仍保持在種子噪聲內。在使用RNA-seq作為輔助數據的全切片圖像TCGA-Lung生存預測中，PANDA在2年OS上相較於僅WSI有所改善（AUC +3.5pp）和Cox PH（C-index +9.0pts），並且超越了全融合訓練，後者的表現不如僅WSI，同時在推理時不需要RNA；在這個較小的隊列上，寬廣的置信區間使得增益低於傳統顯著性。總體而言，PANDA提供了一種面向部署的機制，利用不完整的輔助模態來改善主要模態的預測。
